<div style="text-align: justify;">
The aim of this study was to perform the first large-scale identification of plant-parasitic nematodes in Brazilian maize fields, estimate spatial heterogeneity and predict the probability of occurrence and reach of the damage threshold of specific morphological groups in tropical regions from the influence of different environmental and cultural variables.
